summary: Changing credentials kicks everyone out
description: Right after someone sets a new passcode they are signed out of every device.

summary: iPhone app keeps signing people out
description: Folks on iOS have to sign in again whenever they reopen the application.

summary: Sign in with Google broken since domain move
description: OAuth callback rejected after we switched to the new website address.

summary: Enterprise single sign-on stopped working
description: Identity provider rotated keys and now assertions fail.

summary: Authenticator app codes invalid
description: One time passcodes from Google Authenticator are refused for some accounts in Nairobi.

summary: Shopper billed two times for a single purchase
description: Card was debited twice when the buyer tapped the checkout button more than once.

summary: Wrong money symbol for buyers in Nairobi
description: Amounts appear in dollars rather than shillings.

summary: Mobile money reversal never completes
description: Returning funds to a Safaricom wallet stays waiting forever.

summary: Returning one product gave back the entire basket total
description: Support credited one line but the buyer got everything back.

summary: Courier rejects long street lines
description: Creating a waybill fails because the second line of the address exceeds the carrier limit.

summary: Waybill prints as an empty page
description: Nothing appears on paper when warehouse prints the UPS sticker.

summary: Big boxes quoted too cheaply
description: A 45 kilogram package gets the same price as much lighter ones.

summary: Extra carrier fees not tied to orders
description: Remote area and fuel fees on the courier bill do not line up with sales, so profit looks off.

summary: Status says arrived but buyer has nothing
description: Shipment page claims it reached the customer while the driver is still on the way.

summary: Receipts landing in junk folder
description: Purchase receipts are filtered as unwanted mail by Hotmail.

summary: Forgot password mail missing
description: The recovery message is never received.

summary: Text messages not reaching East African phones
description: Kenyan mobile numbers get no dispatch texts.

summary: Android alerts arrive in pairs
description: Each order alert is shown twice on Samsung phones.

summary: Café not found when typing cafe
description: Diacritics in item names break lookup.

summary: Unavailable items show at the top of results
description: Sold out goods appear before things we can actually ship.

summary: Lookup crawls during promotions
description: Under heavy load in a sale the results take ages and sometimes fail.

summary: Large sellers wait ages for their sales list
description: Vendors with lots of purchases see a very slow listing.

summary: Spreadsheet download truncated
description: Only part of the sales history ends up in the downloaded file.

summary: Weird symbols in downloaded spreadsheet
description: Names with special letters look broken when opened in Microsoft Office.

summary: Overnight slowdown of the whole API
description: Every night around two the main database is maxed out.
